newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline backwardation, supply dull demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline backwardation, supply dull demand.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended unchanged to firmer on Monday after drifting back a little over the afternoon as NYMEX unleaded futures gave up some of their overnight strength and buyers refused to pay the higher prices.

Traders said the combination of lengthy supplies in the ARA region and the steep $4-5 backwardation into July was keeping buying interest thin. They said there had been some movement trans-Atlantic recently despite the very narrow arbitrage but otherwise cargo talk was very thin.
On the key ARA barge market Eurograde continued to talk on a two-tier basis with Rotterdam running refinery barges assessed around $4 a tonne over those with general ARA options.
Prompt Rotterdam refinery liftings were offered around $191 in early business but trade was heard later at $189 a tonne. General ARA liftings were trading around $185/$186 a tonne fob.
July swaps were traded a couple of times at $182 fob ARA in the morning but offered over at this level in late trade.
Eurograde cargoes were assessed around $190 a tonne cif NWE.
